name: Romanian deadlift (barbell)
instructions: Hold the bar in front of your thighs, feet hip width.
Push your hips back and lower the bar down your shins.
Keep your back flat and knees only slightly bent.
Drive your hips forward to stand back up.
cue: Push hips back, keep the back flat
mistakes: Bending the knees too much, turning it into a squat.
